builds.name: Defender of Greil Mercenaries
builds.desc: Volke's basekit is primarily designed for Aether Raids defense. Sturdy Impact helps him survive common physical hits, null follow-up to win matchups and Time's Pulse to pulse Lethality faster. He can shine in a Bridal Catria team where he can pierce through damage reduction and defenses without worrying about weapons/skills with guard affecting his special proc. He can also work in an Infantry Pulse team with pulse support.

builds.name: Assassins of Arena is F**kest Video Ever Made!
builds.desc: If your Volke is +10, you can use him for arena. Volke has 177 BST, meaning he can reach the maximum score of 754 without a duel skill (which is equivalent to low scoring units with R Duel Infantry hitting 754). Therefore, his basekit does not need to be changed other than giving him a premium Rally+ skill or Harsh Command+ for arena scoring. His seal is flexible with Blade Session 3 seal as his best seal.
